headline: Anthropic IPO filing exposes $40B losses and Big Tech dependency
body: Anthropic's IPO prospectus reveals the AI safety company lost over $40 billion last year while remaining heavily dependent on Big Tech partnerships through non-cancelable deals. For healthcare AI stakeholders, this signals potential instability in a vendor landscape where Anthropic positions Claude as a clinically-relevant alternative to OpenAI and Google. Healthcare organizations evaluating Anthropic for clinical workflows, EHR integration, or diagnostic support tools should factor these financial dynamics into vendor selection and contract negotiations. The dependency on Big Tech partners also raises questions about data governance and competitive positioning in value-based care applications.
